entries.heading: None of the funds made available in this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION F—DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 538.  None of the funds made available in this Act may be used 
for first-class travel by the employees of agencies funded by this Act 
in contravention of sections 301-10.122 through 301.10-124 of title 41, 
Code of Federal Regulations.
